what: Open-access journal runs held by this archive, one row per RUN.
why_not_per_article: a row per article would bury the 190 books this archive is built on under a thousand rows of periodical literature, in a file the corpus hall fetches on every visit. The unit that matters is the run; the journal's own site indexes the articles better.
not_extracted: NONE of these is extracted into corpus/. They are tier-3 scholarship and could be, but sweeping several hundred files into the citable set in one commit would be a claim that they were read. Extraction is a separate decision, by touch, recorded when it is taken.

runs.terms: fully open access; colloquium proceedings, free to read and download
runs.note: Proceedings of the Frances White Ewbank Colloquium on C.S. Lewis and Friends, 1997-2016. Conference papers rather than refereed articles, and the distinction matters when citing.
runs.how_obtained: map/oa_fetch.py, a real browser: the publisher's download endpoint answers HTTP 202 behind an AWS WAF JavaScript challenge that curl cannot solve. Every file verified as a PDF by magic bytes and a page count before it was kept.
